title: Federated Learning of Car Aerodynamics Surrogates with Spectral Optimizers
abstract: arXiv:2611.25300v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Neural surrogates predict the aerodynamic forces on a car in seconds, compared with hours for a CFD simulation, but training them requires thousands of CFD simulations of different car designs, which car manufacturers keep proprietary. Federated learning allows several manufacturers to train a shared surrogate without exchanging data. We study which federated optimizer brings such a surrogate closest to one trained on pooled data. On DrivAerNet++, we train a Transolver surrogate across six clients that each hold cars of a single body type, and we compare three spectral optimizers, which orthogonalize the update of each weight matrix (FedMuon and two methods we propose, FedMARS-M and FedOLion), with three non-spectral ones (FedAvg, SCAFFOLD-Adam and FedLion), all tuned with the same protocol. translated_title: 基于谱优化器的汽车空气动力学代理模型联邦学习
translated_abstract: 神经网络代理模型可以在几秒钟内预测汽车所受的空气动力，而CFD模拟则需要数小时，但训练这类代理模型需要对不同汽车设计进行数千次CFD模拟，而汽车制造商将这些设计数据作为专有信息保密。联邦学习允许多家制造商在不交换数据的前提下共同训练一个共享的代理模型。我们研究了哪种联邦优化器能使这样的代理模型最接近在汇总数据上训练得到的模型。在DrivAerNet++数据集上，我们在六个客户端上训练Transolver代理模型，每个客户端仅持有单一车身类型的汽车，并将三种对每个权重矩阵的更新进行正交化的谱优化器（FedMuon以及我们提出的两种方法FedMARS-M和FedOLion）与三种非谱优化器（FedAvg、SCAFFOLD-Adam和FedLion）进行比较，所有方法均采用相同的调优协议。FedMuon和FedMARS-M在每轮仅使用2到4个本地epoch的情况下，其阻力误差达到与使用Muon的中心化训练相差2%以内。非谱方法……
tldr: 本研究在跨车身类型的联邦学习设置下比较了多种优化器，发现谱优化器（尤其是FedMuon和作者提出的FedMARS-M）能训练出性能与中心化训练相差2%以内的汽车空气动力学代理模型。
